title: Very Hard To Use
text:
Very Hard To Use. I'd been wanting one of these for a long time. All the ads make it look so effortless. I decided to try mine out on some banana bread this morning. Tried to use it to cream the butter and sugar. Couldn't make it happen. Didn't work to mash and stir the bananas either. Frankly it was useless to me and I ended up getting the mixer out. Was going to try it on some bread dough that I did today as well, but decided it wasn't worth the mess.

The product itself is very sturdy and well made. I just don't have the hand strength at my age to get it to work.
